exploratoryBlend.note: Equal-weight blend proposed after examining test-set calibration failures. Same historical rows, not an independently validated selected model. Requires future-vintage or untouched-period evaluation.

sensitivity.note: Train issue <= refit minus 25 months; target end at least 12 months before refit. Latest-vintage inputs still revised.

slope.caveat: Investment-basis Treasury yield minus discount-basis bill rate; own proxy, not NY Fed replication.

credit.formula: Mean of all weekly NFCICREDIT observations whose observation dates fall in the complete calendar month
credit.caveat: Public Chicago Fed conditions index; not a traded credit spread; history revised.

labor.formula: Three-calendar-month UNRATE mean (at least 2observations) minus minimum of 12consecutive such smoothed values, including current
labor.caveat: No interpolation. Explicit available-observation policy handles the missing October 2025 release.

limitations: Latest-vintage historical simulation, not a real-time vintage backtest. UNRATE and NFCI history can be revised.
NBER dates are announced after the fact; recent zero labels can later change. The 25-month eligibility sensitivity delays labels but does not reconstruct historical vintages.
Monthly targets overlap for 12 months; monthly tests are not independent trials. Only four recession episodes occur in the evaluation period.
GS10 minus TB3MS is an investment-basis/discount-basis proxy, not a bond-equivalent or New York Fed replication.
Credit subindex is not a traded credit spread; positive means tighter than average. Its full-history normalization is revised.

Three-calendar-month unemployment averages require at least 2available observations. October 2025 is missing in official data; no value is interpolated. Twelve consecutive smoothed values are required for the labor-gap minimum.
The target includes both new recessions and continuation of an existing recession, not recession onset alone.
Probabilities are model estimates, not certainty or investment advice; stress scenarios are conditional sensitivities, not causal forecasts.

spec.name: Credit-conditioned yield curve
spec.hypothesis: Does the relation between curve inversion and future recession risk depend on contemporaneous credit conditions?
spec.refitFrequency: Annual expanding January refits; current estimate monthly refit
spec.designStatus: One fixed interaction specification proposed after viewing 2023 false alarms. No variant search. Chronological replay is not untouched holdout validation.
caveats: Post-hoc hypothesis: comparisons reuse the sample that motivated the design; prospective evaluation is needed.
Same revised-history and NBER announcement-lag limitations as the original model.
Confirmation is a supplementary decision policy, not a probability model or causal claim.
Cases and regime frequencies are descriptive, not independent validation sets.
The 50/50 original-model/base-rate blend is also post-hoc exploration motivated by historical calibration failure, not independently validated.
Surface support counts overlapping training months and ignores proximity in labor.

surface.supportDefinition: Count of training months within radius 0.35 in training-standardized slope/credit space; labor proximity is not required. Counts are overlapping months, not independent episodes.

prospective.note: First captures are frozen at their actual UTC capture time. Outcomes stay pending until all 12 future USREC months are published. Hash-linked public Git receipts provide an inspectable audit trail, not tamper-proof storage or an independent timestamp.
